preconditions.description: A is a positive integer within the specified range.

postconditions.expression: len([x for x in range(1, A+1) if sum(i for i in range(1, x+1) if x % i == 0) == A])
postconditions.description: The output is the number of distinct positive integers x that satisfy the equation J(x) = A. J(x) is defined as the sum of all positive divisors of x.
